title: Corporate Flight Bookings
statement:
An airline runs `n` flights numbered `1` to `n`. Each entry `bookings[i] = [first_i, last_i, seats_i]` reserves `seats_i` seats on every flight from `first_i` up to and including `last_i`.

Produce `answer`, a list of `n` totals where `answer[i]` adds up the seats that all bookings together hold on flight `i + 1`.
notes:
## Intuition

Adding `seats` to every flight in a range one by one costs O(n) per booking, so O(n · bookings) overall. A difference array records only where each range starts and stops: `+seats` at its first flight and `-seats` just after its last. A running sum from left to right then rebuilds every flight's total in one pass.

## Approach

1. Make `diff` of length `n + 1`, all zeros. Flight `f` uses index `f - 1`.
2. For each booking, add `seats` at `diff[first - 1]` and subtract it at `diff[last]` (the index of the flight after `last`; for `last = n` it lands in the spare slot).
3. Walk `i` from `0` to `n - 1`, adding `diff[i]` to `running` and storing it as `answer[i]`.

## Example 1, step by step

`n = 5`. Booking `[1,2,10]` adds 10 at index 0 and -10 at index 2. Booking `[2,3,20]` adds 20 at 1 and -20 at 3. Booking `[2,5,25]` adds 25 at 1 and -25 at 5. So `diff = [10, 45, -10, -20, 0, -25]`. The running sums are 10, 55, 45, 25, 25, giving `[10, 55, 45, 25, 25]`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(n + b) for b bookings: one step per booking and one per flight.
- Space: O(n) for `diff` (the output is not counted).

## Pitfalls

- Flights are 1-based; the answer is 0-based. Mixing them shifts every range by one.
- The closing mark goes after `last`, not at it, so `diff` needs one extra slot for `last = n`.
- Do not include the spare slot `diff[n]` in the answer; it only absorbs closing marks.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `diff` | change in seat count where each range starts or ends |
| `first`, `last`, `seats` | one booking's range and seats per flight |
| `running` | prefix sum of `diff` so far: seats on the current flight |
| `answer` | seats reserved on each flight |

narration.2: One extra slot lets a range that ends at flight n place its closing mark.
narration.4: From flight first onward, every flight gains seats (index first - 1 because flights are 1-based).
narration.5: From the flight after last, the extra seats stop counting.
narration.9: No marks have been passed yet, so the running total starts at zero.
narration.10: Sweep the flights from left to right.
narration.11: The running sum of the marks is the seat count of this flight.
narration.12: Store that total for flight i + 1.
narration.14: Return the totals for all n flights.
